# The VT baselines live here, one .txt per fixture in ../fixtures/vt.
#
# They are generated by tmux (an independent VT implementation) and committed so that the
# comparison runs everywhere without needing tmux. Regenerate them with:
#
#   OPENCRT_VT_WRITE_BASELINES=tests/baselines/vt \
#     out/build/linux-ci/bin/unit_vt_baseline
#
# and review the diff before committing it: a baseline change is a change in what the
# terminal is supposed to draw, and that is a human decision.
